pages.text: $(bold)Damage Overhaul$() rebuilds the vanilla damage system into $(#800080)8 damage types$(). Every weapon, projectile, entity and armor piece can be fully configured through JSON files.$(br2)All features hot-reload in game via commands - no restart needed.
